item.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could happen as soon as today amid talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters Tuesday evening that an announcement on the Strait of Hormuz could happen today or tomorrow, following talks between Iran and Oman.

item.title: McKinney defeats Thanedar in Michigan's 13th Congressional District primary
item.description: Donavan McKinney has defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Shri Thanedar in Michigan's 13th Congressional District, CBS News projects.

item.title: Baby "cocaine hippo" linked to infamous drug lord is rescued in Colombia
item.description: Colombia has around 200 so-called "cocaine hippos" living in the wild, all of which descended from a colony brought to South America by slain cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar.

item.title: Alarming video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian man before exploding
item.description: Russia struck Ukraine with a series of missiles overnight, killing at least 17 people, according to officials. Also, shocking video appears to show a Russian drone chasing a Ukrainian vegetable vendor before exploding and wounding him. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: Why SpaceX stock is falling despite strong revenue growth
item.description: Investors are focused on whether SpaceX will be able to deliver on its ambitious artificial intelligence agenda.

item.title: SpaceX rocket booster slams into moon, creating crater that could be 16 feet deep
item.description: The impact wasn't visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: White House declassifies secret FBI probe on whether Russia was involved in Trump's Comey firing
item.description: The White House released declassified information on the FBI's investigation into President Trump's firing of former FBI Director James Comey, and whether Russia had any involvement in his decision. CBS News' Natalie Brand has more details.

item.title: American Red Cross sounds alarm on national blood supply crisis
item.description: The American Red Cross is warning of a blood crisis as the national blood supply dips to a concerning four-year low. Dr. Courtney Lawrence, American Red Cross' divisional chief medical officer, explains more.

item.title: John James wins Michigan Republican gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
item.description: U.S. Rep. John James, endorsed by President Trump, is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Republican gubernatorial primary race in Michigan, according to CBS News.

item.title: Benson wins Michigan Democratic gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
item.description: Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Democratic gubernatorial primary race, according to CBS News.

item.title: Ukraine says missile interceptors may have saved lives in Russian attack
item.description: At least 17 people were killed after Russia hit Ukraine with a barrage of missiles, Ukrainian authorities said. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: SpaceX shows strong growth but stock drops
item.description: Business journalist Ann Berry shares her thoughts on SpaceX's stock performance and expands on China's response to U.S. sanctions.

item.title: Record-low Danube River levels threaten shutdown of Hungary's nuclear plant
item.description: Three of four units of Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant were not in operation and the fourth was operating at about 50%, as of Wednesday morning.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed reacts to win against Haley Stevens, slams Mike Rogers as "corporate sellout"
item.description: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed reacted to his win against Rep. Haley Stevens in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary. El-Sayed will face Republican Mike Rogers in the November general election. CBS News' Zak Hudak reports.

item.title: History washes ashore as Danube River dries up from drought
item.description: The Danube River is at record-low levels throughout Europe, revealing sunken Nazi warships in Serbia and woolly mammoth bones in Bulgaria.

item.title: What's a good CD interest rate this August?
item.description: Looking to transfer some money into a CD account now? Here are some of the top CD interest rates to look for.

item.title: What to watch for in SpaceX's first public earnings report today
item.description: SpaceX will release its first earnings report as a public company on Tuesday in a key test for the company's stuttering stock price.

item.title: SpaceX rocket booster crashes into the moon
item.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket booster crashed into the moon early Wednesday morning and is expected to leave a large crater on its surface. CBS News' Mark Strassmann has more.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed backer on road ahead in Michigan Senate race after Haley Stevens defeat
item.description: Joseph Geevarghese, the executive director of Our Revolution, a progressive political action organization, joins CBS News to discuss his reaction to Abdul El-Sayed's success in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed will face off against Mike Rogers in Michigan Senate race
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed is expected to move on to a general election race against Republican Mike Rogers. CBS News' Fin Gómez looks ahead.

item.title: How much can debt forgiveness save on a $20,000 balance this August?
item.description: Debt forgiveness can dramatically reduce what you owe, but the final savings aren't always what you'd expect.

item.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed projected to win Michigan Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Former state health official Abdul El-Sayed faced Rep. Haley Stevens in the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan in a closely watched contest that represented the latest test of the party's divisions.

item.title: Disney partners with TikTok to offer creator content on its app
item.description: Disney and TikTok are teaming up to let users create short-form videos that draw on the entertainment giant's large stable of movies and TV shows.

item.title: House Democrats targeting 12 new GOP districts, including Lauren Boebert's seat
item.description: With 90 days until the midterm elections, House Democrats are expanding the map of Republican-held congressional districts they believe they can potentially flip this fall.

item.title: Senator pushes DoD to release probe of Iranian attack that killed 6 U.S. troops
item.description: A CBS News investigation found troops had flagged military leaders about the lack of defenses and insufficient medical supplies ahead of the attack in Kuwait at the beginning of the war with Iran.

item.title: White House declassifies info on secret FBI probe into Trump's firing of Comey
item.description: The White House has declassified information claiming the FBI probed whether President Trump acted as a Russian asset when he fired James Comey, a theory an administration official said wasn't backed up by evidence.

item.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
item.description: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

item.title: Nazi warships, mammoth bones emerge as Danube River dries up
item.description: Water levels on the Danube River have dropped so low that dozens of World War II German battleships – and even the remains of an ancient woolly mammoth — are emerging into view.

item.title: U.S. probes if Iran was behind cyberattack on utilities in Michigan, Minnesota
item.description: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at water systems in at least seven states this week, including Minnesota, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Kevorkian Lawyer Wins Primary
item.description: Geoffrey Fieger's Democrats' Choice In Michigan Governor's Race
